name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: 5 Takeaways From a Heated and Personal Maine Senate Debate
changes.summary: Senator Susan Collins, a Republican, and her Democratic challenger, Troy Jackson, disagreed over the war in Iran and President Trump in the third of four debates in a key race.

changes.title: Iran war and affordability take center stage in Senate debates
changes.summary: The economic backdrop of the 2026 midterms is causing political heartburn for many Republicans. CBS News congressional correspondent Caitlin Huey-Burns joins "The Takeout" with takeaways from the Maine, Georgia and Iowa Senate debates.

changes.title: Breaking down September's CPI report as inflation rises to 3.7%
changes.summary: Inflation accelerated to 3.7% in September as energy costs soared amid President Trump's war with Iran, a new CPI report shows. CBS News reporter Emily Pandise has more.

changes.title: News Wrap: Iran says cargo ship sank after hitting a mine in Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: In our news wrap Wednesday, Iran says a cargo ship sank after hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz, the Vatican says Pope Leo is eating and walking again following surgery to remove a cancerous portion of his lung, the Supreme Court heard arguments in a privacy case rooted in the era of VHS tapes and Netflix is cutti.

changes.title: Iran-backed Houthis strike Saudi oil company Aramco's headquarters, officials say
changes.summary: Iran-backed Houthi rebels hit the headquarters of the Saudi state-owned oil company Aramco in an overnight strike, two regional officials said Wednesday, damaging the offices of the firm's chief executive and other top officials.

changes.title: Why Trump’s Russian Diesel Deal Is Unlikely to Lower Fuel Costs
changes.summary: President Trump’s deal with Russia will probably not lower diesel prices that have soared because of his war with Iran and Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries.

changes.title: How Top Trump Officials Stoked Fears of a Nuke That Could Fry the Power Grid
changes.summary: For more than a decade, conservative activists held that a single atomic bomb could, without killing Americans directly, lay waste to the country — a claim that built fervor for war with Iran.

changes.title: Iran focused on attacking "harder targets," U.K. spy chief warns
changes.summary: Iran has made a "major shift" in its efforts to attack the United Kingdom, including going after harder targets such as military bases, the head of MI5 warned.

changes.title: Houthis Threaten Fierce Retaliation After Saudi Arabia Strikes Yemen
changes.summary: The Iran-backed militia warned it would attack the Saudi energy giant Aramco. The Saudi-led coalition said it was targeting Houthi capabilities.

changes.title: Suspected plot at U.S.-run air base almost certainly directed by Iran, UK prime minister says
changes.summary: A suspected plot to attack a U.S.-run military air base in England was "almost certainly" directed by Iran's Revolutionary Guard, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Monday.
